title: Loni S NDE 6342
content: After a brief visit in a physician's office he determined I had a ruptured ovarian cyst and was rushed the emergency room. I was in intense pain, but alert and conscious throughout the transport. While in the emergency room, my blood pressure fell off to near nothing and I heard the doctor say to my husband and mother, 'We're LOSING HER!' I felt an intense cold and felt like I was 'swimming'. My next thoughts were, 'So this is what it's like to die! No more pain! I should be seeing JESUS!' And I was in His presence within a nanosecond. I was not allowed to 'see' anything at all. The unconditional LOVE and acceptance I felt has no earthly comparison. I was told 'telepathically', as my ears heard nothing, that I could stay and, 'All is well'. I had no memories of my life or earthly associations at that moment. All I wanted was to stay forever in the presence of His light and love. I was so happy to be home! Then He 'reminded' me of my children. I have a 3-yr-old daughter who has a visual impairment and my 9-month old baby boy with Down's syndrome. Without any details, it was made known to me that their lives would be much more difficult and they might not fare well without me. With the reminder of those left behind, I knew I had to return because I loved them so very much and they needed me. Their father was immature and not a very enthusiastic parent who already had difficulties focusing on family. This realization and acknowledgement instantly put me back in emergency surgery with the anesthesia ready to be administered. The surgical repair went off without a hitch and all bleeding was stopped. Recovery was rapid. The children's father died in 2005. I hope and pray he is waiting there for us now.
